places.name: Preysinggarten
places.notes: Really liked it. A bit less casual than usual, but very good.

places.name: Sweet Spot
places.notes: True coffee place, very nice. Roast too light; prefers darker than the current light-roast trend.

places.name: Man Versus Machine (Müllerstr. 23)
places.notes: Went. A good choice. Own-roastery specialty coffee bar in the Glockenbachviertel.

places.name: Nam Giao 31
places.notes: Good, not amazing, but worth the dinner.

places.name: Himalayan Nepali Kitchen
places.notes: Went. Very nice. Focused Nepali kitchen with a real vegetarian section.

places.name: Unbound Coffee Shop (Anichstraße 44)
places.notes: Went. Great place. Own-roastery specialty coffee bar.

places.name: Machete Burrito Kartell
places.notes: Went. Very good. Fun atmosphere, decent food. Focused burrito/taco room.
